structured.reason: an alert is firing on a production service

entries.text: Revision 412 rolled out at 12:19, four minutes before the alert [e2]. Request rate rose 18% in the same window, but traffic is within what revision 411 served last week, so this is not a capacity problem. The image-pull warning on search-canary has been firing for three weeks and is unrelated to this rollout.

structured.root_cause: revision 412 of the search deployment regressed p99 latency
structured.summary: The rollout of revision 412 at 12:19 is the only change in the window [e2]. Traffic is within the range revision 411 served, so this is not a capacity limit, and the long-standing image-pull warning is on a different workload.
causal_chain: p99 latency doubled four minutes later
revision 411 served more traffic without the same latency
remediation_steps: roll back the search deployment to revision 411
bisect the change set between 411 and 412 for the added work per request
